name: Obed
overview: Obed was a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as the son of Shemaiah. His mention is brief and focused solely on his lineage within the Levitical family, with no additional personal notes recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Obed means 'servant' or 'worshiper,' reflecting a proper name of Hebrew origin. This meaning aligns with his Levitical heritage, emphasizing service, though the name itself was not given by God as indicated in the record.
familyAndRelationships: Obed is explicitly recorded as the son of Shemaiah, establishing his place within the Levitical genealogy. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details for Obed.
scriptureSignificance: Obed's significance in Scripture is tied to his position within the tribe of Levi and his descent from Shemaiah. While no additional narrative or roles are attributed to him, his inclusion in the Levitical genealogy underscores the importance of preserving the lineage responsible for temple service and worship in Israel.
